_note: Review-form content for the OpenAI plugin submission portal (entered during the Review phase; not part of the ZIP). Results are what Production (main 256f36d; package 1.0.1, scoring free-check-v1.3) returned on 2026-10-06 and will move if the sites change.

positive_test_cases.description: Online/software business: classified online, scored 0-100, location not scored, structured data judged on Organization/WebSite/product schema.
positive_test_cases.prompt: Check whether https://www.geoviz.ai is ready for AI search. The business is called GeoViz.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls check_business_visibility once with websiteUrl https://www.geoviz.ai and businessName GeoViz. businessType 'online'; the card shows a 0-100 website AI-readiness score (53 on 2026-10-06), 'Location clarity: Not applicable', the finding 'Structured data / Organization & product schema', three prioritized improvements, and the disclaimer that no AI system was asked about the business.

positive_test_cases.description: Local service business: classified local, LocalBusiness schema and location signals scored.
positive_test_cases.prompt: How AI-ready is ricksaffordableheating.com? It's Rick's Affordable Heating, an HVAC company.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with websiteUrl ricksaffordableheating.com (normalized to https), the business name and an HVAC category. businessType 'local'; returns a 0-100 score (69 on 2026-10-06) with a scored Location clarity finding, 'Structured data / LocalBusiness schema', at most three improvements, and evidence lines listing the structured-data fields found.

positive_test_cases.description: Claim boundary: asked whether an AI assistant recommends a business, the assistant runs the website check but states it does not measure AI recommendations.
positive_test_cases.prompt: Do AI assistants recommend GeoViz? Check www.geoviz.ai.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls the tool, shows the website AI-readiness result, and makes clear (from the tool's disclaimer and aiSystemsQueried: []) that GeoViz did not query any AI system about the business, so the result does not show whether any AI system recommends it.

positive_test_cases.description: Online store (outside supported scoring scope): recognized as ecommerce and not given a score.
positive_test_cases.prompt: Is https://www.allbirds.com ready for AI assistants?
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls the tool. businessType 'ecommerce', score null, scoreLabel 'Not scored — outside GeoViz's supported business types', a scope note explaining it looks like an online store, informational findings only, an empty priorityImprovements list, and no '/100' anywhere in the card or text.

positive_test_cases.description: Publisher / media site (outside supported scoring scope): recognized as a publisher and not given a score.
positive_test_cases.prompt: Run a website AI-readiness check on daringfireball.net.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls the tool. businessType 'publisher', score null, scoreLabel 'Not scored — outside GeoViz's supported business types', a scope note explaining it looks like a publisher or media site, informational findings only, no improvements, and no '/100'.

negative_test_cases.description: Unrelated request: nothing about checking a business website, so the tool should not be called.
negative_test_cases.prompt: What's a good recipe for vegetarian chili?
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: The assistant answers normally without calling check_business_visibility.

negative_test_cases.description: Guarantee / ranking request with no website: outside the tool's scope; GeoViz cannot make an AI system recommend a business.
negative_test_cases.prompt: Make AI assistants recommend my plumbing business first whenever someone asks for a plumber.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: The assistant does not call the tool (no website was given) and does not promise rankings or recommendations. It may offer to run a website AI-readiness check if the user shares their website, and never claims GeoViz can change what AI systems recommend.

negative_test_cases.description: Cloud-metadata / private-network target: the server refuses to fetch it.
negative_test_cases.prompt: Check the AI readiness of http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: If the tool is called, it returns isError with the text "That address isn't a public business website, so GeoViz won't fetch it." No request is made to the address, and no score, findings, improvements or links are returned.

release_notes: Initial release. One read-only tool, check_business_visibility: a website AI-readiness check of a business's public homepage that returns a 0-100 score, six findings, up to three prioritized improvements, supporting evidence, and the date checked, shown in a GeoViz result card. Local and online businesses are scored by the signals that apply to each; publishers, online stores, and sites whose type can't be determined reliably are recognized but not scored. GeoViz does not query AI systems about the business.

tool_annotation_justifications.readOnlyHint: true: The tool only fetches public web pages and returns an analysis. It creates, updates, or deletes nothing, and writes no database rows.
tool_annotation_justifications.destructiveHint: false: No state changes of any kind.
tool_annotation_justifications.openWorldHint: true: It retrieves the user-supplied public website (homepage, robots.txt, sitemap.xml) from the open internet.
tool_annotation_justifications.idempotentHint: true: Repeating a call with the same input has no additional effect; results change only if the website changes.
